content.title: 2026 outlook: AI Revolution comes to a halt without energy players
content.description:
Investors can easily look back on the themes that dominated markets (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) throughout 2025, so what are some of the top investment ideas they should be expecting or watching in 2026? Hint: it's still AI. Or more so, the companies that will be physically building out and powering the AI infrastructure.

Hennion & Walsh CIO Kevin Mahn tells Julie Hyman how he is "following the money" and watching the companies that will ultimately become the true architects of the artificial intelligence buildout.
